US-00-01 is built and committed on feature/US-00-01 in /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz (3 commits, not pushed). The final acceptance run passed on the exact head 993eed5 with a clean tree: TC-00-01 and TC-00-03 pass. TC-00-02 and TC-00-04 are manual-only by their specs, so the merge is the owner's call. The PR also adds .github/workflows/acceptance.yml, which needs the owner's own merge anyway.

What was built:
- **App:** started from ordergroup/boilerplate-react-native-expo and upgraded to Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86.3, React 19.2.3 and TypeScript 6. The boilerplate's demo, network and UI-library code was left out (DEC-42). The first screen shows `title`, read at run time from /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/src/content/app.json.
- **Start command (`yarn stack`, /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/scripts/stack.sh):** checks node, yarn, a JDK and the Android SDK, and lists anything missing. It installs dependencies if needed, then uses the running emulator or boots an Android 12 AVD (or the one in `KQ_AVD`). It then runs `expo run:android`. Ctrl-C or SIGTERM stops Metro and the Gradle daemon, plus the emulator if the script booted it. I checked that nothing was left running afterwards.
- **Test command (`yarn test:acceptance`, /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/scripts/test-acceptance.sh):** runs Jest with JUnit output to `$OG_RUN_DIR/junit/unit.xml`, starts the stack with `yarn stack` and waits for Metro and the app. It then runs the flows in /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/tests/maestro with JUnit output to `maestro/report.xml`, and exits non-zero on any failure. I checked that a failing flow makes Maestro exit 1 with failures in the report.
- **CI (/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/.github/workflows/acceptance.yml):** runs on `pull_request`, boots an API 31 emulator and calls only `yarn test:acceptance`. It uploads `test-results/**/*.xml` as `og-test-results` with `if: always()` and `if-no-files-found: error`, plus a separate evidence artifact.
- **Gates:** detect-stack lists `yarn format:check`, `yarn lint`, `yarn tsc`, `yarn test` (Jest with an 80% line threshold). All four pass on a fresh clone.

Things to know:
- **Local emulator is API 32, not 31.** This machine has no API 31 image and no cmdline-tools, so local runs used the API 32 (Android 12L) AVD `Medium_Phone`; CI uses API 31.
- **CI has never run.** The workflow only runs once the PR is pushed.
- **Fixes along the way:** RNTL 14's `render` is async. Maestro's `--flatten-debug-output` wrote no evidence when running several flows, so it is not used. `flowsOrder` has to name flows by their `name:`.
- **Commit trailer left out:** the commits have no Co-Authored-By line, because implementation.md §5 forbids it and the commit hook rejects it.
- **Overlap with US-01-01:** I set the Android application id (DEC-43) and filled `mobile.app_id` in /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/.claude/og-test-targets.json; its comment had said US-01-01 would. The INTERNET permission, minSdk, signing and the component library are left to US-01-01.
